name: Vitals Panel
author: neostryder
description:
A worked example of ModPlugin.hud: it redraws the vitals - your hit points, food, armour and depth - as a graphical panel built from the HudFrame's field names and the engine's own colour attributes, and never reads a terminal glyph.

It takes ONE region. The message line, the status line, the map and every menu are still the game's own screen, which is what per-region ownership is for: a mod that restyles your hit points should not have to take the rest of the interface with it.
